The official Jiangsu platform lists Binhai County (code 320922) and supplies its registration-service redirect endpoint. This evidences a local custodian/workflow, not an open parcel dataset.

requests.outcome: Official county notice fetched successfully. It describes online one-stop registration and cadastral-map online visualized query, but contains no public parcel schema, IDs, geometry, CRS, or API URL.
Official county service page fetched successfully. It links to Jiangsu government service and the county government service map; it does not expose parcel features.
Official Jiangsu one-window registration landing page fetched successfully; it presents city/county selection and does not expose anonymous parcel geometry.

Official current JavaScript configuration fetched. It maps Binhai County (320922) to https://218.206.157.226/estateplat-olcommon/api/v2/jszwfwModel/gjycRedirectUrl; this is a service redirect, not a parcel schema.
Anonymous TLS request timed out after 20 seconds with no response bytes. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, or TLS-verification disablement was attempted.
National map portal returned HTTP 418 to the public request; no Binhai parcel schema or geometry was obtained. Treated as access failure, not absence evidence.
